description: 3DS and DSiWare homebrew title IDs transcribed from the Hacks Guide Wiki user page. Some unique IDs and product codes were derived from source and may not match a release build.
notes: Some unique ID and product codes were derived from source code and may not be accurate to release
type DSiware uses 3DS TWL title-id high 00048004. The DSi equivalent high is 00030004 with the same low.
3DS unique_id is the CIA unique ID, not a DSiWare title-id low.
